note: Counted by hand from data/pages/config__latest__developerguide__what-is-resource-config-coverage.md, then re-counted independently during adversarial review. The page holds 6 tables, one per regional section (line 10 North and South America, 575 Europe, 1095 Asia Pacific, 1614 China, 1918 Africa and Middle East, 2329 GovCloud). The first column of every table is the resource type; every other column is a Region. Column headings: 8 + 8 + 14 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 38 Regions, all distinct, no Region in two tables, and all 38 resolve through resolveRegion. Resource type rows per table: 558, 513, 512, 297, 404, 330. Every table is a subset of the 558-row Americas table and the union is exactly 558, so the page-wide catalogue is 558 types. Resource types are 558 instances of one thing, so they are not the numerator and not separate features; the sibling page resource-config-reference owns the resourceType-axis claim. Yes tally per Region column, read from the word in each cell, against the page-wide 558: us-west-1 385, us-east-1 534, us-west-2 538, us-east-2 476, ca-west-1 187, ca-central-1 462, mx-central-1 197, sa-east-1 412, eu-west-1 501, eu-central-1 502, eu-west-2 461, eu-west-3 411, eu-north-1 415, eu-south-1 340, eu-south-2 263, eu-central-2 265, ap-east-1 365, ap-east-2 89, ap-northeast-1 500, ap-northeast-2 475, ap-northeast-3 344, ap-south-1 467, ap-south-2 289, ap-southeast-1 495, ap-southeast-2 499, ap-southeast-3 306, ap-southeast-4 262, ap-southeast-5 238, ap-southeast-6 120, ap-southeast-7 146, cn-north-1 292, cn-northwest-1 267, af-south-1 366, il-central-1 234, me-south-1 366, me-central-1 310, us-gov-west-1 326, us-gov-east-1 278. Denominator: the page-wide 558, not the size of the Region's own table. Across all 2614 rows in the 6 tables not one row is marked No in every Region of its table, so a table lists exactly the types at least one of its Regions records, and a type a table leaves out is recorded in none of that table's Regions. A per-table denominator would rank us-gov-west-1 (326 of 330 = 98.8%) and cn-north-1 (292 of 297 = 98.3%) above us-west-2 (538 of 558 = 96.4%), which records 212 more types than either. Each note still states the per-table figure as well. Every cell reads Yes or No, none blank. No Region records all 558, so all 38 are partial and none is full. No Region records none, so there are no exclusions. The 8 Regions in regions.json the page never names (eu-isoe-west-1, eusc-de-east-1, us-iso-east-1, us-iso-west-1, us-isob-east-1, us-isob-west-1, us-isof-east-1, us-isof-south-1) are neither covered nor excluded.
